correctness.rationale: Exact conditional crossing expectation for a prescribed span-j chord follows from uniform residual matching and j(2n−2−j) potential crossing pairs, each present with probability 1/(2n−3). Counting 2n chords of non-diameter length, n diameters gives covariance law. Completing the square gives 3(t−j)^2=t(t+1); Pell x²−12b²=1 has precisely powers of 7+2√12 for nontrivial even-y solutions. The standalone verifier checked all matchings n=2..7 and four Pell cases (111 exact assertions). No finite test is used as an infinite proof.
